title.narrative: WOMEN: Work Opportunities and More Empowerment Now
WOMEN: Work Opportunities and More Empowerment Now

description.narrative: EFE-Egypt proposes to empower 275 vulnerable young women in Egypt through skills trainings and jobs. Concretely, this 12-month project will: 1. Facilitate the access of 75 women graduates from Cairo and Giza to employment through a Job Placement Training Programme (JPTP) programme 2. Provide capacity building and skills development for 200 undergraduate women from three governorates in Lower Egypt through a Career Directions (CD) programme At the end of the project, 270 young women will have improved their skills (90 JPTP and 180 CD beneficiaries), while 60 will have found employment, allowing them to indirectly benefit 281 family members (based on Egypt’s average household size of 4.2 people).

EFE-Egypt proposes to empower 275 vulnerable young women in Egypt through skills trainings and jobs.
Concretely, this 12-month project will:
1. Facilitate the access of 75 women graduates from Cairo and Giza to employment through a Job Placement Training Programme (JPTP) programme
2. Provide capacity building and skills development for 200 undergraduate women from three governorates in Lower Egypt through a Career Directions (CD) programme
At the end of the project, 270 young women will have improved their skills (90 JPTP and 180 CD beneficiaries), while 60 will have found employment, allowing them to indirectly benefit 281 family members (based on Egypt?s average household size of 4.2 people).
